mentions.name: Waystops
mentions.description: A map-based travel app for discovering destinations and judging which ones are actually worth visiting. Scores and content are currently seeded by AI, with the eventual goal of becoming user-derived. A native mobile app is in progress; the web version is free to use with nothing paywalled.
mentions.problem: Google Maps is good for route planning and looking up known places but poor for discovery, and tourists/backpackers traditionally rely on guidebooks to learn which destinations are worth going to.
mentions.audience: Tourists and backpackers who want to discover which places are actually worth visiting.
mentions.source_excerpt: Waystops (https://www.waystops.com), a map-based travel app for working out what destinations exist and which are actually worth visiting.
